intro: Dream Bough is a colossal Great Tree nestled on an island in the center of Jademir Lake in northern Feralas. Grown from a sapling of Nordrassil, the ancient tree shelters a mysterious gateway connecting Azeroth directly to the Emerald Dream. Green dragons loyally watch over the sanctuary, keeping unwanted intruders away from its verdant boughs.

p: Rising high above the canopy of northern Feralas, the Dream Bough stands as the largest tree in the region. It was grown by druids following Archdruid Fandral Staghelm, who planted cuttings taken from the World Tree Nordrassil to anchor nature's power across the continent. Situated in the tranquil waters of Jademir Lake, the towering sentinel houses a natural portal carved into its trunk, providing a direct threshold into the untamed Emerald Dream.

Because of its connection to the Emerald Dream, the tree is under the vigilant protection of the Green Dragonflight. Dragonkin and drakes patrol the banks of Jademir Lake and the approaches to the great trunk. While primarily a place of contemplation and slumber for druids wandering between realms, travelers should approach with care, as the green dragons tolerate few uninvited visitors near such an important threshold.
